verdict.rationale: Isaac documents its own programmatic control surfaces: pip-installable Python packages, standalone scripts that control robots and environments, and ROS 2 services and actions to load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations. The evidence shows only overview-level mentions rather than a published API reference, and the OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown-docs probes all returned 404, so the depth of the public API is unproven. missing for 10: a documented public API reference (endpoint or method-level docs), machine-readable API specs (OpenAPI or llms.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
